name: rootaca-growth-os
description: ROOTACA Growth OS — production-ready growth operating system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rootaca/api && npm run build -w @rootaca/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:api: npm run test -w @rootaca/api && npm run test:e2e -w @rootaca/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rootaca/api && npm run lint -w @rootaca/web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build -w @rootaca/web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project rootaca-admin --non-interactive
